psychological_meaning: Boulder, a shade of gray, evokes feelings of stability, neutrality, and sophistication. It is often associated with maturity, reliability, and a sense of calm detachment. Boulder can also represent a blank canvas, suggesting potential and possibility while maintaining an understated elegance.
